$schema: ShopSmart seeded-violation ground truth. Field names mirror ARCHITECTURE.md Appendix A (axeRuleId, wcagCriteria, impact, page) for direct cross-validation against real axe scan output.
activationRule: An instance is ACTIVE in build N if introducedInBuild's index <= N's index AND (fixedInBuild is null OR fixedInBuild's index > N's index).
countingNote: countedAsViolation defaults to true and is omitted on most records. 5 instances (duplicate-id-aria x2, form-field-multiple-labels x3) are explicitly countedAsViolation:false, axeResult:'incomplete' -- axe-core 4.12.1 empirically classifies these seeded patterns as 'needs review' rather than a confirmed violation (see catalog.md 'Empirical corrections'). Build totals in this file count only countedAsViolation !== false instances.
